description: This grouped bar chart, titled “How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception,” illustrates the “Ratio (%)” for three language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across two categories: “Songs” and “Basketball.” The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, is scaled linearly from 60 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis contains the two categories, “Songs” and “Basketball,” ordered from left to right. For the “Songs” category, the blue bar (Llama3) reaches approximately 92%, the red bar (Qwen2) reaches approximately 94%, and the yellow bar (ChatGPT) reaches approximately 80%. For the “Basketball” category, the blue bar (Llama3) reaches approximately 86%, the red bar (Qwen2) reaches approximately 78%, and the yellow bar (ChatGPT) reaches approximately 83%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each category, with no indication of sorting or emphasis on any specific bar.
